figures.shows: The Game page of the Project Settings panel after project.setGameInfo: start scene Outpost, loading scene Loading, title Moon Crab, version 1.2.0, company and copyright Tidepool Games, and the icon with its preview
figures.caption: The Game page holds what a player sees of the game: its title, version, company, copyright and icon. The project's name stays out of this page, since it keys the save folder.
figures.alt: The Project Settings window on its Game page. The start scene is Outpost and the loading scene Loading. The title reads Moon Crab and the version 1.2.0; company and copyright are filled, and a small preview shows the icon.
